stem: The poem is mostly about a speaker who —

options.label: A
options.text: is chosen for a role in a play that he doesn’t understand

options.label: B
options.text: has trouble with his lines after seeing his classmates in the audience

options.label: C
options.text: experiences problems onstage but is able to finish his performance

options.label: D
options.text: can hardly wait to be onstage because he has practiced so much
